name: Audit Hash-Chain Compromise
summary: Tamper-evident audit chain has reported chain_verified=false. Tampered rows in the tenant chain invalidate the SOC2 / GDPR / PDP trust boundary; this runbook drives the first 15 minutes of response per NIST SP 800-61 Rev 2 and triggers regulator notification timers (GDPR 72h, PDP 24h).

steps.title: Confirm TSA cert validity + pinned CA chain
steps.description: Verify the per-tenant RFC 3161 TSA certificate has not expired and that the pinned CA cert under audit.chain.pinned_ca_pem is reachable. Without a valid TSA anchor the recovery step cannot prove a last-good period.

steps.title: Baseline last good TSA-verified period
steps.description: From the audit_anchor_runs table, identify the latest run with verified=true. This (run_id, anchored_at) pair is the trust boundary the recovery phase will restore against.

steps.title: Page on-call IR + legal counsel
steps.description: Page primary IR engineer, security on-call manager, and outside legal counsel via the configured rotation (see docs/runbooks/audit-chain-compromise.md §Communication). Spin up the dedicated #ir-audit-chain channel.

steps.title: Re-verify the chain via verify_chain_snapshot
steps.description: Run sx-cli audit verify --signing-key-env <env> --source <dump> on a fresh export of the hot tail. Confirm the break is reproducible and capture the failing (seq, expected_hash, actual_hash) triple. Also call POST /v1/audit/anchors/verify/{last_run} to confirm whether the TSA-anchored Merkle root still holds.

steps.title: Identify tampered row range
steps.description: Map every audit row whose seq is at or above the break seq into the suspect range. Pull the prior 100 rows for context. Snapshot the IDs and the cumulative byte size before they can be re-written.

steps.title: Start regulator notification timers
steps.description: Mark t0 as the moment chain_verified=false was confirmed (NOT when it was first observed). Configure timers: GDPR Art. 33 (72h), Indonesia PDP (24h), customer contractual notice (per MSA, usually 24-72h). The DPO owns the clock.

steps.title: Trip the engagement kill switch
steps.description: POST /v1/safety/kill-switch with reason='audit_chain_compromise'. Halts every active engagement/scan/autonomous remediation so the tampered window does not grow while forensics is in progress.

steps.title: Block new audit writes via feature flag
steps.description: Flip SX_AUDIT_WRITES_FROZEN=1 in the runtime config (or call the admin endpoint). The audit recorder honours the flag and returns 503 ServiceUnavailable for every append. This MUST happen before pg_basebackup so the backup captures a stable trailing offset.

steps.title: Snapshot Postgres WAL via pg_basebackup
steps.description: Capture a write-ahead-log + base backup with `pg_basebackup -D /var/forensics/audit-$(date +%s) -X stream -P -v`. Encrypt and ship to the immutable forensics bucket (s3://sentinelx-forensics/ with Object-Lock COMPLIANCE mode).

steps.title: Document evidence chain-of-custody
steps.description: Open a chain-of-custody record (one per artifact: pg_basebackup, sx-cli verify dump, anchor reply, system journal). Each entry: collector name, collection ts, sha256, storage URI, witness signature.

steps.title: Trigger root-cause analysis
steps.description: Spin up an RCA ticket. Top hypotheses: (a) compromised DB superuser credential, (b) signing key leak from KMS, (c) bug in the recorder's seq monotonicity guard, (d) corrupted disk causing torn writes. Each hypothesis MUST have an assigned investigator + a kill-or-confirm deadline.

steps.title: Restore from last TSA-verified period
steps.description: Using the baseline from `prep-last-good-baseline`, restore audit rows up to and including the last verified anchor's covered seq range. Replay events recorded after that point from object storage (per-event WORM copies kept by the recorder).

steps.title: Re-anchor the restored chain
steps.description: Fire a fresh anchor run against the restored chain via the AnchorRunner. Confirm the new run row carries verified=true and that POST /v1/audit/anchors/verify/{new_run_id} succeeds against the pinned CA. Lift SX_AUDIT_WRITES_FROZEN once the new anchor is persisted.

steps.title: File regulator notifications (GDPR 72h, PDP 24h)
steps.description: Send the regulator notification letters using the templates in docs/runbooks/audit-chain-compromise.md (§Templates). GDPR Art. 33: data protection authority + affected data subjects when high risk. Indonesia PDP UU 27/2022 §46: PDP-RI within 24h. Copy outside counsel on every notification.

steps.title: Notify affected customers
steps.description: Send the customer notification email (template C in the runbook). Include the trust-boundary window (last good ts → recovery ts), the rows affected per tenant, and the remediation status. Set up a follow-up office-hour slot for tier-1 customers.

steps.title: Run a blameless post-mortem
steps.description: Within 10 business days. Cover: detection latency, key-rotation hygiene, RBAC of DB superuser, sufficiency of TSA anchoring cadence, and whether the verifier interval (currently 5 min) needs to shrink. Publish the post-mortem to the security wiki and tag the RCA ticket.

steps.title: File control-uplift tickets
steps.description: One ticket per identified gap; each with an owner and 30/60/90 deadlines. Examples: shorten anchor cadence, add a second TSA, move the signing key to an HSM, narrow the DB superuser blast radius.
